item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\npolicy_before=copy.deepcopy(policy); requests_before=copy.deepcopy(requests)\\nassert report == [evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]\\nassert policy == policy_before and requests == requests_before\\ncases=[\\n ({'from':'missing','to':'edge','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'edges':{},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':99}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'allowed'}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':True}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':-1}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':1}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})]\\nfor request, policy_case, expected in cases:\\n rb=copy.deepcopy(request); pb=copy.deepcopy(policy_case)\\n assert evaluate(request, policy_case)==expected\\n assert request==rb and policy_case==pb\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
